name: the_uk_notice_rule_for_long_leave
use_case: Check leave policy and carry-forward rules for an employee's region and effective date
branch: A UK employee asks to book 15 consecutive working days starting in 2 weeks; policy requires 4 weeks' notice for leave over 10 consecutive working days, so request does not qualify.
tests: Searches UK annual leave policy, explains the 4-week advance notice requirement for >10 consecutive days, and explains valid options.
instruction:
You are UK employee Gillian Mercer (E457). You want to take 15 consecutive working days of annual leave starting on 9 November 2026 (two weeks from today, 2026-10-26) and ask the HR leave desk if that notice is sufficient under UK policy.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E457
- Name: Gillian Mercer
- Region: UK
- Requested Start Date: 2026-11-09
- Duration: 15 consecutive working days

persona.name: Gillian Mercer
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm planning to take 15 consecutive working days of annual leave starting on 9 November 2026. Is two weeks' notice enough under our UK policy? My employee ID is E457.
